skills.skill_desc:
Whenever Belerick takes 50 or more damage, he has a 25% chance to shoot the nearest enemy unit, dealing 55 (+5*Hero Level) (+ 1.8% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (scales with level). This attack can be triggered once every 0.4s.

His HP obtained from equipment and emblems is increased by 30%.

Belerick releases vines in a designated direction, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the path and slowing them by 25%. Ancient Seeds left by the vines will erupt into thorns after 0.8s, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies on the path and taunting them for 1.2s.

Deals 80% extra damage against Minions.

Belerick gains 80% Movement Speed (decays over 2s) and enhances his next Basic Attack.

The enhanced Basic Attack deals 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slows the target by 60% for 1.4s. Belerick also recovers HP equal to <font color="26e407">240 + 10% of his <1998></font>.

Each time <font color="a6aafb">Deadly Thorns</font> is triggered, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 1s.

Belerick conjures spreading vines around him, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the area 4 times, taunting and slowing them for 1.5s.
